user.title: Extend a Kodi media player
user.description: Better Kodi adds a queue, URL casting and handover to a media player of the built-in Kodi integration. The Kodi integration stays set up and keeps working.

data_description.hide_source: Better Kodi's media player replaces it in dashboards and Assist. It is shown again when you remove Better Kodi.

connection.title: Connection to Kodi
connection.description: Better Kodi also talks to Kodi directly for the queue. These settings were taken from the Kodi integration for {entity_id}; change them if needed.

data_description.ws_port: Used for live updates of the queue. Requires "Allow remote control from applications on other systems" in Kodi (Settings → Services → Control). Leave empty to turn live updates off.
Used for live updates of the queue. Leave empty to turn live updates off.

cannot_connect.message: Could not connect to Kodi at {host}.

invalid_auth.message: Kodi rejected the user name or password.

play_only.message: This link ({resolver}) can only be played right away, not added to the queue.

enqueue_not_supported.message: Items of type "{media_type}" can only be played right away, not added to the queue.

invalid_target.message: {target} is not another Better Kodi media player.

target_not_ready.message: {target} is not ready. Is its Kodi reachable?

call_method.name: Call method
call_method.description: Calls a Kodi JSON-RPC method and returns Kodi's response.

method.name: Method
method.description: Name of the JSON-RPC method, for example Player.GetActivePlayers.

get_queue.name: Get queue
get_queue.description: Returns Kodi's video queue with positions, titles and the current item.

remove_from_queue.name: Remove from queue
remove_from_queue.description: Removes an item from the queue. The item that is playing cannot be removed.

position.name: Position
position.description: Position of the item, starting at 0.

move_queue_item.name: Move queue item
move_queue_item.description: Moves an item to another position in the queue.

position.name: Position
position.description: Current position of the item, starting at 0.

to_position.name: New position
to_position.description: Position the item should move to, starting at 0.

handover.name: Hand over
handover.description: Continues the current playback with its queue on another Kodi.

target.name: Target
target.description: The Better Kodi media player that should take over.

keep_source_playing.name: Keep playing here
keep_source_playing.description: Don't stop playback on this Kodi.

resume.name: Resume at the same time
resume.description: Seek to the same position in the current item.
